comments.author: sentinel-review
comments.body: What happens if the process dies between the failure and the re-enqueue? Consider tracking the delivery's phase explicitly so a sweeper could find stuck deliveries.

comments.author: danov
comments.body: Fair point for a crash window. Added a `DeliveryPhase` enum and a phase column so state is visible.

comments.author: sentinel-review
comments.body: Phase writes happen in both sender.py and queue.py and could interleave. Suggest an explicit transition table so illegal jumps fail loudly rather than corrupting state.

comments.author: danov
comments.body: Added the `ALLOWED` transition table. Also added a `PARKED` state — gives operators a place to put a delivery if a sweeper ever finds one in a bad state.

comments.author: sentinel-review
comments.body: During a partner outage operators may want retries off without a deploy. A config flag would cover that.

comments.author: danov
comments.body: Added `webhook_retry_mode` with `off` and `single`. I put `adaptive` in as a placeholder value so the setting won't need a migration if we ever do backoff.

comments.author: sentinel-review
comments.body: `payload` could be None if a row predates the insert-time validation.

comments.author: danov
comments.body: That validation shipped in 4.2 and the table was backfilled, but I added the guards anyway to be safe. A None payload now parks the delivery.
